title: Are LLMs Good Financial User Simulators? A Preliminary Study
abstract: arXiv:2609.15727v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as user simulators, but their ability to reproduce evolving individual financial decisions remains unclear. We present a preliminary study in a controlled paper-trading environment with 120 volunteers. Participants used non-redeemable virtual funds under real-time market conditions; no real brokerage accounts, real-money positions, or real transaction records were accessed. Given only information available before a prediction cutoff, a simulator predicts the participant's next-trading-day action, traded security, and transaction quantity. We evaluate temporally aligned rolling predictions and compare settings with and without point-in-time market information. Market context improves action and ticker prediction in the controlled ablation, while transaction sizing remains difficult. We also observe systematic behavioral compression: models overproduce hold actions, underpredict sell decis

translated_title: 大语言模型是优秀的金融用户模拟器吗？一项初步研究
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型越来越多地被用作用户模拟器，但它们重现个人不断演变的金融决策的能力仍不清楚。我们在受控的模拟交易环境中开展了一项包含120名志愿者的初步研究。参与者在实时市场条件下使用不可兑换的虚拟资金；研究未访问任何真实的经纪账户、真实资金头寸或真实交易记录。在仅给定预测截止时间点之前可获得的信息的情况下，模拟器预测参与者在下一个交易日的行动、交易的证券和交易数量。我们评估了时间对齐的滚动预测，并比较了包含与不包含时点市场信息的设置。在受控消融实验中，市场上下文信息改善了行动和股票代码的预测，而交易规模的预测仍然困难。我们还观察到系统性的行为压缩：模型过度产生持有行为，低估了果断卖出……
tldr: 该初步研究表明，大语言模型在受控模拟交易环境中能够部分重现个人金融决策，市场上下文信息可提升其对交易行为和标的的预测能力，但交易规模预测仍然困难，且模型存在过度预测持有、低估卖出的系统性行为压缩偏差。
en_tdlr: This preliminary study shows that LLMs can partially reproduce individual financial decisions in a controlled paper-trading environment, where market context improves action and ticker prediction, but transaction sizing remains difficult and models exhibit systematic behavioral compression by overpredicting holds and underpredicting sells.
